name: one tool replaces eight, at one low price
looks: A single clean app panel with eight small coloured feature tiles (store, bookings, DMs, scheduler, courses, community, analytics) sits beside a short claim and a single bold monthly price, directly replacing the messy pile of separate tools from before.
build: ui-tilt-card for the app panel (shallow tilt, soft shadow), its eight tiles fanning in on variant-stack-reveal's staggered spring; the single price rolls up small and fast, in contrast to the earlier big scary total.
sound: A clean, single confident chime as the price settles.
prompt: Show a single clean product panel made of several small feature tiles fanning in together, beside a claim that it replaces many separate tools, and one bold, low monthly price. Let the calm, single price visually answer the chaotic, expensive pile from the problem beat.
